---
name: Bug report
about: Something in the app, API or website is broken
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

## What happened

A clear, short description of the problem.

## What you expected

What should have happened instead.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Go to …
2. Click …
3. See …

## Where

- [ ] Flutter web app (`/app/`)
- [ ] Flutter mobile / desktop
- [ ] API (`server/`)
- [ ] Public website (`site/`)
- [ ] Docs / startup kit

**Environment:** OS, browser/version, app URL, and whether it was local or hosted.
**Account type:** worker / employer / staff / not signed in (do **not** include passwords or tokens).

## Evidence

Screenshots, console output or request IDs. Please redact any personal data, credentials, tokens and identity documents.

## Trust invariant check

If this involves verification, payments, shifts or reputation: did the UI claim something ("verified", "paid", "published") that the system had not confirmed? This is our highest-priority class of bug.

---

> For security vulnerabilities, **do not** open a public issue. See [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Innovator123-sudo/kalla-lai/blob/master/SECURITY.md).
